title: Tight Energy Supply with Mixed Growth Outlook
description: Geopolitical tensions, OPEC+ output cuts, and shipping disruptions keep energy prices high, lifting input costs and inflation risk, while manufacturing weakness and supply-chain frictions signal softer global demand—producing a mixed macro outlook.

title: Monetary Tightening, Dollar Strength, and a Global Risk-Off
description: Persistent inflation and hawkish central-bank guidance keep policy rates elevated, lifting the dollar and tightening financial conditions. This environment weighs on risk assets—especially tech stocks—and suggests slower global growth amid persistent market volatility.
